programme.title: Andy's Wild Workouts

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Okai's Ghanaian Okra Stew: Okai has invited his friends over for a traditional Ghanaian meal made using okra. He works very hard in the kitchen to make a lovely tasting, colourful stew for them to enjoy. S2 E15

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Circus: Bluey is the ringmaster in a game of circus with her friends, but Hercules wants to play his motorcycle game instead. Luckily Bluey has a solution to keep everyone happy. S2 E32

programme.title: My Pet And Me: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Earwigs: Rory, Sandy and Zoe find earwigs at a nature reserve. Chantelle meets a superbug expert. S3 E5

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
programme.desc: Hey Quacky!: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors. S1 E2

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: Juice: Dee encourages a friend to say `juice', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. There's orange juice, apple juice, tomato juice and sip-it-in-the-heat juice. S4 E14

programme.title: Dinopaws
programme.desc: The Thing That Rescued Us: Gwen, Bob and Tony bounce very high from some mushrooms and get stuck in a tree. S1 E28

programme.title: Roots & Fruits
programme.desc: Festive Special: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Carrot, Potato, Parsnip and Brussels Sprout perform the festive classic Auld Lang Syne - if Potato lands from the moon on time. S2 E1

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Orinthocheirus & Sand Dollar: Andy Day looks at the one of the largest flying pterosaurs, the Ornithocheirus, to help find the skeleton of the Sand Dollar, a sea creature which spent its life on the ocean floor. S1 E10

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Movies: It is Bluey's first trip to the cinema, but she's worried that the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out. S2 E28

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Young Veggies: Part 2: Supertato reveals how he learned to control his potato powers, defeat Evil Pea and save the supermarket for the very first time. S2 E28

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Going Slow Badge: The Squirrels are rushing around, so Duggee shows them how to take a slower pace. S2 E25

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: T: Dee encourages a friend to say 't', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We meet a turtle, shake our tails and see a tiger in a tall tent! S7 E20

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Hollywood, USA: After winning a part in a Hollywood film, Glitch is not happy when he has to work with Kyan to finish a scene. S3 E2

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Decorating Donkey: It's nearly time for Tortoise to wake up from hibernation so Sarah plans a pretty surprise. S2 E20

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bike: Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try. S1 E11

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Mosses: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on an eco quest to find out all about mosses. S2 E13

programme.title: Dog Loves Books
programme.desc: Dog Loves Amazing: While trying to solve a puzzle, Dog and Pug end up looking for a minotaur in an ancient maze. After a number of false turns, they reach the centre and find the friendly minotaur. S1 E6

programme.title: Andy's Wild Adventures
programme.desc: Polar Bears: Andy and Kip embark on a wild adventure to the frozen arctic in search of polar bears. S1 E30

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Hey Duggee: Songs
programme.desc: Heads, Shoulders, Knees And Toes: Sing along to Heads, Shoulders, Knees and Toes with Duggee and the Squirrels. S1 E10

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Charades: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track. S2 E11

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Treasure: Morris and Pearl have lost one of their medals in the canal. Stanley fishes it out only have the complete collection dropped in. Stanley dons a diver's suit and goes after them. S1 E6

programme.title: Dinopaws
programme.desc: The Thing That Took Us On An Adventure: The Dinopaws are looking for an adventure when the meet Percy - a Dinopaw adventurer. S1 E34

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures

programme.title: Kit & Pup
programme.desc: Wool: Pup is using a ball of wool to knit a hat for Kit, but he can't seem to knit the correct size. S1 E38

programme.title: Go Jetters

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: X: Dee encourages a friend to say 'x', and they go on an adventure around the sound. They meet a Tyrannosaurus rex, a fox with chicken pox and an ox on a box! S7 E24

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Born Yesterday: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his day. S3 E6

programme.title: Hey Duggee
